content:
While Claude using computers on desktop platforms isn't new, the ability to run it in the background is a welcome upgrade.

Anthropic announced today that background computer use for Claude Code is rolling out, currently available on macOS for Pro and Max subscribers.

OpenAI's Codex, later renamed ChatGPT, earlier this year was first to bring background computer use to the Mac. It's great to see Anthropic's Claude Mac app improve on its version.

When AI-powered computer use means handing over mouse control to an agent, it's far less useful. But when it can run in the background, it's a significant multitasking breakthrough for Mac users.

Learn more about Claude's computer use features in Code and Cowork.
